info.title: Attestly Trace Ingestion API
info.description: Imports agent runtime trace data into an Attestly AI system, so EU AI Act Annex IV documentation can be drafted from real evidence rather than a manual description. This is the only Attestly endpoint published for external/agent use — see /auth.md for how to authenticate.

post.summary: Import trace events for an AI system

ai_system_id.description: Must belong to the authenticated API key's organization.

events.description: Pre-normalized events. Provide this OR payload, not both.

data.description: Arbitrary structured fields for this event

payload.description: Raw trace data in the native format of `source` (object or array), parsed server-side. Provide this OR events, not both. Note: api_history has no parser implemented yet and will currently be rejected.

400.description: Invalid payload, or no parser available for the given source

404.description: ai_system_id not found in the authenticated organization

bearerAuth.description: An Attestly API key (format: atly_live_<48 hex chars>). Provisioned by a human account owner via the dashboard, not self-registrable. See https://attestly.online/auth.md.
